John Kingsley Birge, The Bektashi Order of Dervishes (Luzac/Hartford, 1937)
Foundational study of Bektashi doctrine, cosmology, the Allah-Muhammad-Ali triad, Kirklar/cem tradition, and Haji Bektash Veli
Markus Dressler, Writing Religion: The Making of Turkish Alevi Islam (Oxford UP, 2013)
Genealogy of modern Alevi identity, the Alevi understanding of the Ali-centric triad, and the Kizilbash-Alevi tradition's formation
David Shankland, The Alevis in Turkey: The Emergence of a Secular Islamic Tradition (RoutledgeCurzon, 2003)
Ethnography of Alevi cem ceremony, dede/ocak system, Muharrem/matem observance, and Anatolian Alevi belief and practice
Ahmet T. Karamustafa, God's Unruly Friends: Dervish Groups in the Islamic Later Middle Period 1200-1550 (Univ. of Utah Press, 1994)
Antinomian Anatolian dervish milieu (Abdalan-i Rum, Qalandars) underlying Bektashi formation
